name: EGD Finance claimAllReward prices rewards from live pair balances
summary: EGD_Finance.claimAllReward converts each stake's USDT-denominated reward quota into EGD as quota * 1e18 / getEGDPrice(), and getEGDPrice divides the EGD/USDT pair's live USDT balance by its EGD balance. Inside a flash swap that removed 99.99999925% of the pair's USDT, the attacker claimed the reward of an 18-block-old 100 USDT stake, received 5.61M EGD (99% of the contract's EGD) and sold it for about 36k USDT.

loss.notes: The EGD Finance proxy paid 5,614,105.648378533801366233 EGD to the attack contract. Its disposal in the same transaction realised 36,054.121156865234135946 USDT, the EGD/USDT pair's net USDT outflow; EGD's 10% transfer tax withheld 561,410.56 EGD for token fee recipients, and that share is included in the quantity but realised nothing, so the effective unit value is below the pre-attack spot of 0.008094 USDT per EGD. USDT at par. The attacker's 100 USDT stake (transaction 0x4a66d01a017158ff38d6a88db98ba78435c606be57ca6df36033db4d9514f9f8) and the 10 USDT flash-swap fee are not netted; the honest reward due was about 0.0003 USDT.

ageReset.description: ProxyAdmin 0x8f8c3495800c708eae49df3269c60e9575240b41 upgrade(proxy, 0x93c175439726797dcee24d08e4ac9164e88e7aee) moved the EIP-1967 slot from 0x35afc46f5392304eab8e57ecfc4a93170db415e2 to the exploited implementation. A second upgrade to the same address at block 19968082 re-emitted Upgraded without changing code or state.

sources.note: Loss. Receipt of source-1 (block 20245540, index 0, status 1; sender 0xee0221d76504aec40f63ad7e36855eebf5ea5edd -> attack contract 0xc30808d9373093fbfcec9e026457c6a9dab706a7): log 0 flash swap of 2,000 USDT from WBNB/USDT pair 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae; log 1 424,456.221210335857574110 USDT flash-swapped out of EGD/USDT pair 0xa361433e409adac1f87cdf133127585f8a93c67d; log 2 EGD 0x202b233735bf743fa31abb8f71e641970161bf98 5,614,105.648378533801366233 from the EGD Finance proxy to the attack contract, with Claim event log 3 carrying the same amount; log 4 425,729.589873966865146832 USDT repaid to the EGD pair; logs 8-11 the attack contract's EGD sale, 5,052,695.083540680421224 EGD into the pair and 561,410.56483785338013600 EGD (1%+4%+5%) to fee recipients 0x3cb0fe8b5ac9d36f22465424412d3e76988747e6 and 0x922d672f7e6e57c6481038e3cf63c529d88bc70d; log 13 37,327.489820496241708668 USDT out of the pair; log 16 2,010 USDT flash repayment; log 19 36,044.121156865234135946 USDT to the attacker EOA. Pair net USDT outflow 424456.221210335857574110 + 37327.489820496241708668 - 425729.589873966865146832 = 36054.121156865234135946. EGD.balanceOf(proxy) at block 20245539 was 5,670,246.68272468733197; getEGDPrice() there was 0.008093644493314726e18 and calculateAll(attack contract) 0.000322881944444418e18.

Root cause, anchor and age. Verified EGD_Finance implementation source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid 56, address 0x93c175439726797dcee24d08e4ac9164e88e7aee; v0.8.4+commit.c7e474f2, optimizer 200; SHA-256 of returned SourceCode 81ab809c0680ff64d0f7a133cd40fe9a8c41254d088563ee2a1c78480a722e0d), contracts/contrtact/EGD_Defi.sol: getEGDPrice returns U.balanceOf(pair) * 1e18 / EGD.balanceOf(pair); claimAllReward sums quota * 1e18 / getEGDPrice() and transfers that EGD. Balance reads are manipulable mid-flash-swap, before the pair's k check. pair() at block 20245539 is 0xa361433e409adac1f87cdf133127585f8a93c67d, set by initialize(); the proxy's txlist has no setPair/setToken/setRouter call. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 txlist of the proxy through block 20300000 returns 581 transactions (creation, 264 bond, 183 stake, 47 claimAllReward, 86 setUserisRefer); EGD tokentx through block 20245540 yields 205 hashes, of which only 4 are not top-level proxy calls: two EGD funding transfers from 0x87ac1fd06ce7f06d70d087b386f1a6926252039b (blocks 19974483, 19974510), the attacker's stake 0x4a66d01a017158ff38d6a88db98ba78435c606be57ca6df36033db4d9514f9f8 (block 20245522, pair->proxy 8,628.56 EGD rebuy) and source-1. Top-level EOA claims cannot move pair balances within the transaction, so source-1 is the first manipulated claim. Age: EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc is 0x35afc46f5392304eab8e57ecfc4a93170db415e2 at block 19968060 and 0x93c175439726797dcee24d08e4ac9164e88e7aee at 19968061, 19968082 and 20245539. Upgraded logs (topic 0xbc7cd75a...) for the proxy: blocks 19938531 (creation) and 19938575 select 0x35afc46f...; 19968061 (source-3, index 0, log 0) and 19968082 (0x866befed1d6699b8fec53127cfe2620c981627d4758e94a565ca66588b72df08, index 2, log 6) both select 0x93c175...; the next, 20249474, selects 0x3ba22e48148b35392752f94e514a2c3c4678c1a4 after the exploit. Both 19968061 and 19968082 are ProxyAdmin 0x8f8c3495800c708eae49df3269c60e9575240b41 upgrade(address,address) (0x99a88ec4) calls from owner 0xf1971eb3e7102f491b87b56aef67aea4c561f1f8 with identical arguments; the second carries no data and changes no code, so the first activation supplies the age. eth_getCode: implementation empty at 19968056, keccak 0x50d6f1c1e84a92099cb171eee896d47801ece4d8e9547567ad9f43ae466443a9 at 19968057, 19968061 and 20245539 (source-4, top-level creation by the same owner at index 4); proxy empty at 19938530, keccak 0xfc1ea81db44e2de921b958dc92da921a18968ff3f3465bd475fb86dd1af03986 from 19968056 through 20245539 (source-2, index 7).
